newsitem.title: USA: New York Health Care completes IPO.
newsitem.headline: New York Health Care completes IPO.

text.p: New York Health Care Inc said Tuesday it completed an initial public offering and has begun trading on the Nasdaq SmallCap market and the Boston Stock Exchange.
The offering, underwritten by H.J. Meyers & Co Inc, consisted of 1.25 million shares of common stock at $4 per share, the company said in a release.
Proceeds will go to acquisitions of businesses, other expansion opportunities and general working capital purposes, the company said.

New York Health Care, a licensed home health care agency that supplies paraprofessionals who deliver a broad range of health care support services to patients in their homes, operates in all five boroughs of New York City and the New York counties of Nassau, Westchester, Rockland, Orange, Dutchess, Ulster, Putnam and Sullivan.
